I'll calculate 82^9 and then sum its decimal digits.

[{"tool_name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "python3 << 'EOF'\n# Calculate 82^9\nresult = 82**9\nprint(f\"82^9 = {result}\")\n\n# Sum the decimal digits\ndigit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in str(result))\nprint(f\"Sum of digits = {digit_sum}\")\nEOF"}}]
